answer: Sybil containment binds identity generation to bonded capital: every candidate node deposits 1,500 jade tokens into escrow before submitting peer reviews. A verifier network aggregates evaluations across each identity vertex, comparing submitted grades against median consensus. When an agent's scores diverge past tolerance bounds, the protocol slashes 80% of deposited funds and writes an immutable slash trail on-ledger. This forfeiture triggers a debt spiral that permanently de-weights linked keys, forcing adversaries to burn fresh capital for each forged identity.
